content.text: Now I understand. The endpoint is `POST /api/owners` → `addOwner`. The test creates two owners with the same telephone and expects `409 Conflict`. Let me check how the DTO/mapper handles telephone and confirm the mapper.

The mapper already normalizes telephone (strips non-digits) when mapping from `OwnerFieldsDto`, and every owner created via this endpoint is stored normalized. So the check reduces to comparing the already-normalized value against existing owners. I'll add a minimal duplicate check to `addOwner` only, keeping the edit to a single method in a single file.
